A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the saturation properties of symmetric nuclear matter can be explained by a two-region model of nuclear forces, where the quark degrees of freedoms are used to describe the short range repulsive force and the nucleon degrees of freedoms are employed to describe the long range attractive force.
the quark degrees of freedoms are not essential for understanding the saturation properties of the nuclear matter.
